fields.content: A for loop repeats a block of code a specified number of times according to its initialization, condition, and update components.
fields.procedure_name: Steps of a Java for loop
steps: Declare and initialize a loop counter variable (e.g., int I = 0).
Write a boolean condition that determines loop continuation (e.g., I < 5).
Provide an update expression to modify the counter after each iteration (e.g., I++).
Place the loop body statements to be repeated.
Execute: initialize counter, evaluate condition, run body, apply update, repeat until condition is false.

fields.content: A loop that reads input, uses break to exit on "quit", continue to skip on "pass", and prints other inputs.
fields.procedure_name: Handle special input commands in a loop
steps: Read user input inside the loop.
If the input equals "quit", execute a break statement to terminate the loop.
If the input equals "pass", execute a continue statement to skip printing and start the next iteration.
Otherwise, print the input.

fields.content: Use an infinite loop with a break statement to repeatedly ask the user for a value until it falls within the allowed range.
fields.procedure_name: Validate numeric input using an infinite loop
steps: Wrap the input prompt inside a while true loop.
Read the user input.
Check if the input satisfies the required range (e.g., between 1,000 and 1,000,000).
If the input is valid, break out of the loop; otherwise, display an error message and repeat.
